source: Marsupial Roster Planner sheet, 'Villains & guests' tab, snapshot 2026-11-13
note: Planning data, not a game file. Boss names are placeholders (see docs/VILLAINS.md).

villains_and_guests.fact: Looks like the happiest animal on Earth and lives on its own island (Rottnest).
villains_and_guests.idea: Smiling island rulers secretly behind the invasion: they shipped in the toads, rabbits and foxes. Final world is their island (in-game: Grin Isle); final boss, the Grand Grinner.

villains_and_guests.fact: Brought to Australia in 1935 to eat cane beetles; poisonous, and has spread across the north.
villains_and_guests.idea: World boss: the Cane Toad King. Poison clouds; the quolls must avoid them.

villains_and_guests.fact: Two dozen rabbits released in 1859 grew into plagues that stripped the land bare.
villains_and_guests.idea: Swarms that eat your power-ups; the bilby's arch-rivals.

villains_and_guests.fact: Brought over for hunting in the 1800s; preys on small marsupials.
One of the biggest threats to small native mammals.
villains_and_guests.idea: Stealthy ambushers that hide in long grass.

villains_and_guests.fact: A monotreme: lays eggs, and males have venomous ankle spurs.
villains_and_guests.idea: Neutral mentor or shopkeeper; running gag that it isn't allowed in the tournament.
Rolls into a spiky ball as a hazard or ally.

villains_and_guests.fact: Famously "won" the 1932 Emu War against soldiers with machine guns.
Has a dagger-like claw on each foot and a powerful kick.
Arrived thousands of years ago; culturally important to many Aboriginal peoples.
villains_and_guests.idea: Neutral wanderer rather than a villain.

villains_and_guests.fact: Its call sounds like loud laughter.
villains_and_guests.idea: Laughs at you when you get knocked out.
